propositions: Project routing overlay cannot extend built-in overlay triggers; both glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays read only committed routing and hardcoded patterns
Implement additive trigger_tokens (literal substring matching on diff lines) and applies_to globs (union with committed globs) on project entries keyed by built-in overlay ids

Add project_trigger_extensions helper in registry.py to read raw project overlay entries and return trigger extensions per overlay id, unioned by glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays
Thread repo_root from overlay_union call site through trigger functions to access project overlay without changing effective_routing semantics for thresholds

Project entries with trigger_tokens or applies_to on built-in ids must fire content and glob triggers respectively; malformed entries (non-list tokens, non-string token values, unknown ids) are silently ignored
